body:
## Why This is a current break on the shipped demo path. `docs/UserGuide.md:289-292` states that when `regime.enabled` is true, CLI exports and the unified HTML report include a **Performance by Regime** table. `config/demo.yml:54-59` enables regime detection with proxy `SPX`, and `config/demo.yml:84-89` enables `multi_period`, which is the path `trend run` takes. `src/trend_analysis/api.py:454-457` delegates to `_run_multi_period_simulation` whenever `multi_period` is present, and that function (`src/trend_analysis/api.py:132-284`) never populates `performance_by_regime`, `regime_notes`, or `regime_summary` in the returned `RunResult`. Regime aggregation is implemented only on the single-period portfolio stage at `src/trend_analysis/stages/portfolio.py:889-973` via `build_regime_payload`. `src/trend/reporting/unified.py:630-632` therefore renders `

Regime analysis unavailable.

` even though regime is enabled and `demo/demo_returns.csv` contains an `SPX` column. On tip `adda9a41`, `trend report -c --output unified.html` produced a report whose `#regimes` section reads **Regime analysis unavailable** (audit evidence under research-program artifacts). ## Scope Wire multi-period `trend run` / `run_simulation` results so enabled regime configuration produces the same `performance_by_regime` payload and export/report surfaces that the single-period portfolio stage already builds. ## Tasks - [ ] After `_run_multi_period_simulation` assembles combined portfolio returns in `src/trend_analysis/api.py`, call `src/trend_analysis/regimes.py` `build_regime_payload` with the configured regime section, benchmark proxy column, and combined user/equal-weight return series so `RunResult.details` includes `performance_by_regime`, `regime_notes`, and `regime_summary`. - [ ] Pass those fields through the export path in `src/trend_analysis/export/__init__.py:934-988` for multi-period runs so `analysis_summary` text and workbook narrative include regime rows when the table is non-empty. - [ ] Add `tests/test_multi_period_regime_exports.py` asserting `trend run` on a minimal multi-period fixture with `regime.enabled: true` and an in-data proxy column yields a non-empty `performance_by_regime` table in the structured result consumed by `src/trend/reporting/unified.py`. ## Acceptance Criteria - Named test: `pytest tests/test_multi_period_regime_exports.py::test_multi_period_run_populates_performance_by_regime -q` passes and proves the unified report HTML contains `Performance by Regime` without the `Regime analysis unavailable` fallback when regime is enabled on a multi-period config with a valid proxy column. - Deliberate-break → revert: temporarily skip the new `build_regime_payload` call in `src/trend_analysis/api.py` → `tests/test_multi_period_regime_exports.py::test_multi_period_run_populates_performance_by_regime` must fail → revert the skip. - `pytest tests/test_trend_reporting_unified_helpers.py -q` passes so existing regime HTML formatters remain stable. ## Non-Goals - Do not remove or disable `multi_period` scheduling in `config/demo.yml`. - Do not change regime label algorithms in `src/trend_analysis/regimes.py` beyond wiring them into the multi-period API result. - Scaffold-only completion does NOT count: returning an empty `performance_by_regime` frame while leaving the unified report fallback unchanged is a failure of this issue. _Reproduction (tip `adda9a41`): install package, set `data.csv_path` to absolute `demo/demo_returns.csv`, keep `regime.enabled: true`, `regime.proxy: SPX`, and a `multi_period` block; run `trend run -c CONFIG --no-cache` then `trend report -c CONFIG --output report.html`; observed: report `#regimes` shows **Regime analysis unavailable**. Expected: non-empty Performance by Regime table per `docs/UserGuide.md:289-292`._ _Surfaced by Track D repo-audit 2026-09-23; verified by live CLI/report exercise on isolated audit configs._
